$comment: Vidak ontology proposal v1 (Playlist). schemaId is intentionally omitted — MetaState must assign a stable W3ID and publish this schema before W3DS_ONTOLOGY_ADAPTER_ENABLED may be turned on. Do not invent schema IDs.
title: Playlist
description: Ordered collection of Video MetaEnvelope references owned by a creator eName.

id.description: MetaEnvelope object id within the owner eVault (local W3ID / UUID).

ownerEName.description: Owner eName. Mapping Rules ownerEnamePath resolves to this identity.

channelId.description: Reference to the Channel MetaEnvelope object id.

thumbnailFileUri.description: Optional playlist thumbnail as a w3ds://file URI.

items.description: Ordered playlist membership. videoId values are Video MetaEnvelope object ids.
